expected_structural_delta: One retirement record in the existing ledger and two bounded broker methods; no new store, coordinator, worker lifecycle or general deletion path.
minimum_design: Extend the existing broker with an atomic retained retirement record, exact snapshot comparison and original-owner attestation; keep the database in place and refuse every ordinary operation after retirement.
outcome: Retire an empty shared budget without allowing stale admission or discarding original ownership evidence.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing bbolt broker transaction and snapshot validation
reuse_decisions.rationale: The ledger owner must fence retirement and stale operations atomically.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing provider window and host-policy owner
reuse_decisions.rationale: The caller retains responsibility for maintenance, complete census and exact original-policy restoration.
